📰 每日 AI 新聞 Top 10 · 2026-11-23
1. Anthropic mathematician and Claude claim proof of the Riemann Hypothesis, confirmed by Lean研究
Anthropic 數學家攜手 Claude 破解黎曼猜想，Lean 正式確認證明正確
Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge worked with Claude on a formalized proof of the Riemann Hypothesis, about 17 million lines of code. The Lean and Mathlib communities issued a joint statement on Nov 21 confirming it is correct.
Levent Alpöge 與 Claude 合作，完成約 1,700 萬行程式碼的黎曼猜想形式化證明。Lean 與 Mathlib 社群於 11 月 21 日發表聯合聲明，確認證明正確。
iThome · 原文連結
2. OpenAI brings ChatGPT Dots and Space to Plus subscribers產品
OpenAI 將 ChatGPT Dots、Space 提供給 Plus 方案用戶
OpenAI is opening its always-on agent Dots and the collaborative workspace Space to Plus users. Dots runs 24/7 on a dedicated cloud computer and browser, and currently uses the GPT-6 Astra model.
常駐代理人 Dots 與協同作業區 Space 開放給 Plus 用戶。Dots 透過專屬雲端電腦與瀏覽器 24 小時自主執行任務，目前使用 GPT-6 Astra 模型。
iThome · 原文連結
3. How Notable Capital, GIC, and Baillie Gifford bet big on Anthropic before its IPO產業
Notable Capital、GIC 與 Baillie Gifford 如何在 Anthropic 上市前重注押寶
Three major backers explain what gave them the conviction to invest billions in Anthropic ahead of its IPO.
三家重要投資方分享，是什麼讓他們在 Anthropic 上市前下注數十億美元。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
4. AI inference supply chain leaks prompts; OpenRouter disables three providers資安
AI 推論供應鏈傳出提示詞外洩，OpenRouter 停用 3 家供應商的服務
Dragos sent nearly 2 million test prompts and found at least three AI inference providers had been compromised. In one case the attacker obtained AWS test keys and tried to reach cloud services.
Dragos 用近 200 萬筆測試提示詞，發現至少 3 家 AI 推論服務供應商遭入侵，其中一起事件的攻擊者取得 AWS 測試金鑰並嘗試存取雲端服務。
iThome · 原文連結
5. Chinese hackers use AI attack framework Cairn to exploit a medical-imaging zero-day within 11 minutes資安
東亞多所大學遭鎖定，中國駭客用 AI 攻擊框架 Cairn 在 11 分鐘內利用醫療影像 AI 軟體零時差漏洞
Attackers used an AI agent to discover and exploit a zero-day in the open-source medical imaging software MONAI Label. They gained root access on university servers.
攻擊者透過 AI 代理程式自行發現開源醫療影像軟體 MONAI Label 的零時差漏洞並成功入侵大學伺服器，取得 root 最高權限。
iThome · 原文連結
6. Banks Have Had It Up to Here With Your AI Agent政策
銀行受夠了你的 AI 代理
Major US financial institutions are banning third-party bots from logging into customer accounts. They also warn that any costly bot mistakes are the customer's responsibility.
美國大型金融機構禁止第三方機器人登入客戶帳戶，並表示機器人造成的任何損失由用戶自行承擔。
Wired · 原文連結
7. Signal to block Siri and Gemini screenshots on mobile產品
Signal 將封鎖手機版 Siri、Gemini 螢幕截圖
Signal is restricting OS-level AI agents from capturing and storing its screen content. After blocking Windows Recall last year, the measure extends to iOS 27 and Android.
Signal 逐步限制系統內建 AI 代理人截取並儲存其畫面。去年已先封鎖 Windows 的 Recall，這項措施將擴大到 iOS 27 與 Android。
iThome · 原文連結
8. Microsoft discloses GitHub Copilot CLI phishing risk that could let attackers control AI agents資安
微軟揭露 GitHub Copilot CLI 釣魚攻擊風險，駭客恐藉合法登入程序操控 AI 代理
Attackers can abuse the legitimate device-code login flow to trick developers into approving access and obtain OAuth tokens. Under certain conditions they could remotely control the AI agent and run commands on the user's machine.
駭客可利用合法的裝置驗證碼登入機制，誘騙開發者核准而取得 OAuth 權杖。在特定條件下，還可能遠端操控 AI 代理並在使用者電腦上執行命令。
iThome · 原文連結
9. OpenAI's chief scientist has thoughts on how to limit AI development政策
OpenAI 首席科學家談如何限制 AI 發展速度
To set a speed limit on AI development, you first need to agree on how to measure speed. OpenAI's chief scientist shares ideas on this.
要替 AI 發展訂出速度上限，必須先對「如何衡量速度」達成共識。OpenAI 首席科學家分享了他的看法。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
10. Microsoft to retire To Do in 2027; business users move to Planner, consumers get no replacement產品
微軟明年淘汰 To Do，企業用戶轉向 Planner，個人用戶無替代方案
Microsoft will shut down Microsoft To Do on June 30, 2027 across all platforms. Enterprise and school users move to Planner, while personal users get no equivalent and no automatic data migration.
微軟將於 2027 年 6 月 30 日全面淘汰 Microsoft To Do。企業與學校用戶轉向 Planner，個人用戶沒有替代產品，資料也無法自動移轉，引發不滿。
iThome · 原文連結
